title: Padded configuration-validity CNF
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, and let $C,n,s\in\mathbb{N}$. Relabel the configuration-validity CNF by assigning its encoding bits consecutive natural-number indices, then append negative unit clauses forcing every index from the number of encoding bits up to, but not including, $C(s+n+1)$ to be false.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet
